items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was like Scottie Pippen with the Chicago team.

ctx.x: Rather than them getting more money, they added you?

It was like Scottie Pippen with the Chicago team. “I don't take less money because I want to win. I want to win it.” We went from this, and I liked— They said, “No moaning Art. No ‘this here, over there, over yonder.’ We want to create our own book.’” “Go to it gentlemen.”
